    BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ IN JAPAN (2026.4.17) [Weverse] (2160p 4K)​


    ​
    The ARIRANG WORLD TOUR is the fourth concert tour by the South Korean boy band BTS, in support of their 2026 studio album, ARIRANG. The tour began on April 9, 2026, in Goyang and continue through 2027. Marking BTS's return to live performances after completing their mandatory military service, it spans more than 85 dates in 34 cities across 23 countries.

    ​
    IRENE ASIA TOUR 2026 [ I-WILL ] is the first solo concert tour by South Korean singer Irene. The tour follows the release of her first full-length album, Biggest Fan, on March 30, 2026. The tour was announced in March 2026 through the official Red Velvet social media platforms and related announcements. This marks Irene's first solo concert tour after being a member of Red Velvet and her previous work as a part of the sub-unit Irene & Seulgi. The Seoul concerts, which open the tour, will take place for two days, from May 23 to 24, at the Jangchung Gymnasium.
    ​
